input-field.name: sitemapRefreshTime
input-field.label: Refresh interval
刷新间隔
input-field.helpText: Enter the interval in seconds. This is active only in live mode.
请输入以秒为单位的刷新间隔。仅实时模式使用此设置。

input-field.name: sitemapRefreshStrategy
input-field.label: Refresh strategy
刷新策略
input-field.helpText:
Manually: refresh with php bin/console sitemap:generate.
Scheduled: refresh through scheduled tasks every 24 hours.
Live: refresh at the interval defined above when the sitemap is requested.

手动：通过 php bin/console sitemap:generate 命令刷新。
定时任务：每 24 小时通过定时任务刷新。
实时：请求站点地图时，按上方定义的间隔刷新。

input-field.name: excludeLinkedBlogs
input-field.label: Exclude link-only blog posts from the sitemap
从站点地图中排除仅链接可见的文章
input-field.helpText: Blog posts that are only available through a direct link are excluded from the sitemap.
仅可通过直接链接访问的文章不会出现在站点地图中。
